observations: Many blue plastic drums/barrels stacked outdoors/in a yard.
Each drum has a screw/bolt-style lid with metal hardware visible.
No obvious cracks or holes are clearly visible in these photos, but surfaces are dusty and some lids are angled.
Some drums show scuffs/staining consistent with prior use.
No readable brand/model/volume marking is visible on the drum faces in the provided photos.

identity.kind: plastic storage drums (food-grade water storage type)

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos show only generic plastic drums; no chemical compatibility rating or liner/spec sheet is shown.
No food-grade certification stamp/label is readable on the drums in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water.
claims.evidence: Photos show prior-use wear/staining; cannot confirm single-use history.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: Lids appear present in photos, but leak/crack status cannot be confirmed visually from these angles.

risks.risk: Leakage or micro-cracks not visible in photos (especially around lid seals and seams).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of one drum filled with water (or a pressure/tilt test) showing no seepage around the lid and bottom seam.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used drums with unknown leak status (assume may need inspection/possible replacement of lids/seals).

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade / no certification or wrong plastic grade/liner.
risks.proof: Request clear close-up photos of any stamp/label (food-grade/NSF/WRAS) and the drum material code, plus a receipt/spec sheet if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-certified used plastic drums (food-grade not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Capacity/size mismatch (price depends heavily on whether they are 20L/25L/50L/100L/200L).
risks.proof: Request a photo showing the drum capacity marking (e.g., liters) or a tape-measure shot of height/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely capacity tier for storage drums until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Lid/seal condition varies across the stack (some lids may be missing gaskets or have warped rims).
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of lid gaskets/rims on 2–3 different drums (front, side, and underside of lid).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming lids may need gasket replacement/adjustment.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any markings: capacity (liters), brand, and any food-grade/certification stamp on the drum body or lid.
Video of one drum filled with water to the top, showing no leaks around lid and bottom seam.
Close-ups of lid seals/gaskets on at least 2–3 drums from different parts of the stack.
A photo with a measuring tape (height and diameter) if capacity marking is not readable.
response.reason: The photos confirm used plastic storage drums with lids, but key factors that determine safe use and price in Rivers (food-grade proof, leak status, and exact capacity) are not verifiable remotely from these images.
